decisions.reason: False positive: the Definition begins 'Use the matrix group G_2=SU(2)' and defines mu_2 on that group. Its finite link measure is the product of mu_2 over the positive edges, whose domain is necessarily SU(2)^{E+}; the stated link matrices and their finite products therefore lie in SU(2), the domain of tau. The generic G in the cited reusable lattice datum does not override this explicit local group selection.

Confirmed fatal logic gap: old Verification step 1.1 concluded the unnormalized four-link partition factor from F3's normalized plaquette law. A normalized law is unchanged when its unnormalized weight is multiplied by a positive constant, so that implication does not determine Z_square. Repaired by integrating A first in U_p=A B C^{-1} D^{-1}: right invariance of mu_2, supplied by the one-plaquette average lemma, and finite-probability Fubini prove the unweighted Haar pushforward. Applying it to exp(beta tau) gives Z_square=exp(-beta) z_beta; applying it to weighted Borel indicators proves the original holonomy law.
